description: Changes existing elements by id. Give only the fields to change; the rest of the element is kept. Fields use the same names as board_add (x, y, width, height, stroke, fill, strokeWidth, dash, label for a box, text for sticky and text elements, name/attributes/methods for a umlClass, cells for a table, points for a line or arrow, color for text and lines). Set fill or dash to null to remove it. Connectors accept routing, relation, stroke, strokeWidth, dash, fromPort and toPort; freehand strokes accept color, width and dash. An element's type cannot change. The element is read, merged and validated before anything is sent. Changes appear live for everyone who has the board open.

boardId.description: Board id (a UUID) from board_list or board_create.
